outcome: Vascular contraction to serotonin and phenylephrine
Expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS)
cohort: Omental arteries collected from normal pregnant women undergoing cesarean section, incubated with microparticles isolated from either normal pregnant women or preeclamptic women.
finding: Circulating microparticles from preeclamptic women, but not from normal pregnant women, induced hyporeactivity to vasoconstrictor agonists, upregulated inflammatory markers (iNOS, COX-2, NF-kB), and increased oxidative stress (superoxide anion, 8-isoprostane) in omental arteries from normotensive pregnant women.
